definitions.gloss: half-eaten (food); something one has started eating
definitions.explanation: Food that someone has begun to eat and not finished, often with the idea that they will come back to it. Used before a noun with の: {食|た}べかけのパン.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧。
{食|た}べかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are half-eaten sweets on the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{食|た}べかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The phone rang, so I left the table with my meal half-eaten.

notes:
Formed from the stem of ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ and かけ, which marks an action begun and not finished ({読|よ}みかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}, a book one is partway through).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べかけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: left half-eaten
- {食|た}べかけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a half-eaten portion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{残|のこ}し→食べ残し：33938_tabenokoshi⟧: food left uneaten, given up on
- {飲|の}みかけ: a half-finished drink — the same pattern
